note: Site configuration for the Use Cases collection. Titles, questions and view lists are authored here; every empirical number is declared as a path into a tracked evidence artifact and read at render time, never copied into this file or into JavaScript.

cases.title: DFlow: Slippage Threshold Lineage
cases.question: What remains observable after a named slippage threshold becomes an unsigned Solana transaction?
cases.summary: A bounded bracket experiment: anchor, treatment, anchor. It asks which response-layer quantities can still be located once the order becomes transaction bytes — and records, explicitly, which cannot.

reproducibility.note: Public mode verifies the tracked evidence snapshot. Raw captures are not published.

cases.title: DFlow: Platform Fee Accounting
cases.question: How does a requested platform fee appear in the quoted amounts, and can it be traced further?
cases.summary: A separate, smaller run against the quote surface. It stops at the response layer: this endpoint returned no unsigned transaction, so nothing downstream of the quote can be checked.

reproducibility.note: The recorded run is private. The tracked evidence projection is what this page renders.

cases.settlement: not observed — quote surface returns no transaction
